x-v1: Verdict rule. The models disagree about the sign here, not the size: above eye level on a plane, below it on a globe. Photograph the summit against the disc. Above → the plane prediction holds and the globe's is refuted. Level or below → no k on a plane can produce that.
x-v2: Verdict rule. Both models put this summit on the same side of eye level; the test is the {diff} gap, {pct}% of a disc. The far ridge carries the same gap along 3° of skyline, azimuth 238.1° to 241.2°, and the crossing at 241.29° is where the sign argument lives.
